responsibility: Declares the DragonFly BSD-specific driver option table used by GCC’s generated option handling. It introduces the DragonFly-supported spellings for assert/defsym/rpath/soname, plus posix, profile, pthread, and rdynamic, so they can participate in specs and command-line decoding. The file is declarative option metadata rather than implementation of DragonFly linking behavior.
same_name_distinction: Within the DragonFly same-name pair, this file is only declarative option metadata for driver switches such as assert, defsym, rpath, soname, posix, profile, pthread, and rdynamic; dragonfly.h contains the real target configuration and link/spec definitions that use them.
